MuScriptor Local 1.0 Beta — Apple Silicon

Download official release assets from:
https://github.com/PokestirVGM/MuScriptor-Local/releases

1. Unzip the archive and move MuScriptor Local.app into Applications.
2. Open it and let the private Python environment finish installing.
3. Choose Small, Medium, or Large. Open that model's terms link and accept it.
4. Create a read token at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens.
5. Paste the token into the app and choose Connect & Download.
6. Drop in audio, review the MIDI destination, and change the folder if needed.
7. Click Transcribe. Cached models work offline after setup.

Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 or later. Model memory requirements
vary by size. Allow roughly 10 GB for setup with Large, plus room for your audio
and additional models. Performance and transcription accuracy vary.

This beta is locally signed, not Apple-notarized. macOS may require approval in
System Settings > Privacy & Security. Obtain the app from the release page above.

Your audio stays on your computer. Each model size needs its own Hugging Face
access and terms acceptance. Downloads display their actual local folder.
No credentials, recordings, MIDI files, or model weights are included.

Wrapper code: MIT. Official MuScriptor code: MIT, copyright Kyutai x Mirelo.
Model weights: CC BY-NC 4.0 plus the model owner's additional terms.
The wrapper license does not grant rights to the models or to input audio.
License and attribution files are included in the archive's Legal folder.
This is an independent community wrapper, not an official upstream application.

Private engine: ~/Library/Application Support/MuScriptor Local/Engine/
Recovered MIDI: ~/Library/Application Support/MuScriptor Local/Results/
Logs: ~/Library/Logs/MuScriptor Local/ (also available through Show Logs)

To update, quit, replace the app with a newer release, and reopen it.
Repair Dependencies repeats environment setup if needed. To uninstall, trash
the app and remove its private engine folder. Save recovered MIDI before removing
Results. Remove model caches only if they are not needed by other software.

Full documentation: https://github.com/PokestirVGM/MuScriptor-Local
